observations: Photo 0 shows a single car headlight assembly.
The assembly is wrapped in clear plastic film.
The lens is clear but shows some surface haze or dirt.
The orange turn signal lens is visible on the right side.
A watermark 'PUREGOLD GLOBAL' is visible across the center.
No brand, model, or part number is legible in the photo.

claims.claim: All kia and Hyundai genuine spare parts and accessories are available
claims.evidence: The photo shows only one part; the seller's claim is about a broad inventory.

risks.risk: The part may be a generic aftermarket replacement rather than a genuine OEM part.
risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's part number (PN) or a label showing the brand.

risks.risk: The internal bulb or electrical socket may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the headlight showing the bulb and wiring.

risks.risk: The plastic housing may have cracks or deep scratches not visible under the film.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the plastic housing without the film.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and part number.
Photo of the back of the headlight showing the bulb and wiring.
Photo of the plastic housing without the protective film.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
